column3: NKJV has “from floor to ceiling,” where the Hebrew reads “from floor to floor.”
NKJV spells the name חִירָם as “Huram” here.
NKJV reads “two rows of pomegranates … on top,” where the Hebrew has “pillars” and “pomegranates” in each other’s places.
Close to the Hebrew; הַמְּכֹנוֹת (“the stands”) is rendered “carts.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the stand” is rendered “the carts.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the stand” is rendered “cart.”
